brief.objective: Reconstruct the supplied synthetic reference screen as semantic, responsive UI while preserving its observable hierarchy and copy without baking the screenshot into the implementation.
brief.audience: A reviewer comparing a working reconstruction with the supplied reference at native dimensions.
brief.surface: Northstar Relay command-center screen reconstructed from a synthetic reference frame.
acceptance_criteria: Major anchors, region order, proportions, text hierarchy, and visual relationships match at 1440x900.
The implementation uses semantic HTML/CSS/components and does not use the reference as a full-screen background or flattened image.
The reconstruction remains usable at 768px and 375px with deliberate transformations for dense regions.
Observable copy and identity-neutral geometry are matched; inferred behavior is labeled rather than presented as reference fact.
A fidelity ledger records geometry, typography, spacing, color, imagery, and state differences with evidence.

references.notes: Compare native dimensions, anchors, region order, and crop.
Use surface, border, type, and density relationships as evidence; do not assume hidden design tokens.
Match relationships and contrast, not merely sampled hex values.

must_include: Reference navigation rail, top bar, primary route brief, status summary, activity chart, and handoff table
Native readable text and controls with the observed region order
A comparison ledger at the reference viewport plus intermediate and mobile checks
must_avoid: Using the entire reference as a background, screenshot, or canvas image
Inventing below-the-fold screens or hidden behaviors as observed facts
Replacing observable copy with lorem ipsum
Changing product identity or adding effects to hide fidelity gaps
technology: SVG/raster only for visual content actually present in the reference
accessibility: Use semantic landmarks, headings, buttons, and table semantics where applicable.
Do not let fidelity justify inaccessible contrast, focus, labels, or reflow.
responsive: At 1440x900, match reference geometry and native crop before polish.
At 768px, transform rail and dense table deliberately.
At 375px, preserve primary status and route action in usable reading order.
constraints.notes: Reference handling: the synthetic fixture supplies observable identity-neutral composition, style, and color evidence; it does not authorize copying hidden behavior or protected expression. Product specificity: preserve route-handoff vocabulary and command-center purpose, not a generic dark dashboard. Edit when reference relationship is correct but a local geometry/type/spacing/responsive discrepancy remains; regenerate structural decomposition only when it is wrong, never flatten the reference. Stop at threshold, no material correction, budget exhaustion, reference block, or marginal improvement.

states.description: Interactive controls expose visible keyboard focus.
Selected route detail remains semantically usable.
Inferred empty state is labeled as an extension, not reference fact.

expected_artifacts.role: native reference plus intermediate and mobile comparison renders
fidelity ledger for navigation top-bar route-brief status and activity

immutable: Observable reference copy, region order, primary action meaning, and native dimensions
Distinction between observed facts and inferred behavior
high_sensitivity: Major anchors, crop, proportions, typography hierarchy, and surface relationships
flexible: Implementation primitives, hidden behavior, responsive transformation, and non-observable states
forbidden_inference: Do not infer unseen routes, business rules, data truth, or brand ownership from a synthetic frame.
Do not call the result pixel-perfect without native render comparison evidence.
